name: Spotlight cards
for: A row of plain feature cards (security, admin, settings): a fine ruling sits faintly in each card's empty top-right corner, and a small soft light under the pointer brings that corner up; the cards themselves never move.
how: One still effect host over the row, masked per card by a fade from the top-right corner (roundRectFade) that is gone well before the icon and the text, and by a 150px radial light at the pointer. The marks are a quiet step of the ink on the card colour.
rules: The only pointer-following element on the page.
The effect never reaches the icon, the title or the body text.
Pattern effects only (rulings, contours) at a few percent of the ink: never colour blobs, never a mesh.
a11y: Each card is an article with a heading and one real link that covers the card. Keyboard focus lights the focused card's corner. The effect is still; reduced motion moves the light without easing.
